spans.view: with a round cream table beside him

beats.text: Pax stands by a round table scratching his head with a wooden mallet, eyeing the piggy bank on it
Pax swings the mallet down and smashes the piggy bank into shards and a few banknotes, then winks
Pax holds the mallet up and looks at the pile of shards and banknotes with a sheepish smile

spans.view: with a red open-top car around them, a peach sky with drifting clouds behind

beats.text: Polly and Pax sit side by side in the open car holding tacos in both flippers and chewing
Pax lifts his taco and takes a big bite, eyes open, while Polly opens wide, bites hers and chews with eyes shut
Polly chews happily with her eyes closed and rosy cheeks while Pax chews beside her at the steering wheel

spans.notes: camera locked: compare 126/177 shows black edges on the car, windshield, trees and hills; only the clouds drift (ECC on the sky band is thrown by them).
